factors.label: Healthy food retail mix (mRFEI)
factors.description: Healthy outlets as a share of all food outlets (higher = healthier mix).

factors.label: Fast food & convenience density
factors.description: Fast-food restaurants and convenience stores per km² of tract.

factors.label: Alcohol outlets nearby
factors.description: Liquor stores, bars and pubs within 1 km of the tract's centre.

factors.label: Tree canopy
factors.description: Average tree canopy cover across the tract (30 m satellite data).

factors.label: Public open space
factors.description: Share of the tract that is publicly accessible parks, conservation land or recreation areas.

factors.label: Distance to public open space
factors.description: Straight-line distance from the tract's centre to the nearest publicly accessible open space (0 if inside).

factors.label: Traffic proximity & volume
factors.description: Daily traffic count at major roads within 500 m, divided by distance. Used as a road-noise proxy.

factors.label: Traffic volume density
factors.description: Daily vehicle-kilometres driven inside the tract per km² (traffic counts × road length). Used as a road-noise proxy.

factors.label: Near an active railway
factors.description: Share of the tract within 300 m of an active commuter or freight railway. Used as a rail-noise proxy.

factors.label: Fine particulate matter (PM2.5)
factors.description: Annual average PM2.5 concentration (EPA air-quality model).

factors.label: Nitrogen dioxide (NO₂)
factors.description: Annual average NO₂, mostly from traffic combustion.

factors.label: Diesel particulate matter
factors.description: Diesel exhaust particulate concentration (EPA AirToxScreen).

factors.label: Distance to health centre or hospital
factors.source: MassGIS (DPH community health centres, acute & non-acute hospitals)
factors.description: Straight-line distance from the tract's centre to the nearest community health centre or hospital.

factors.label: Transit stops nearby
factors.source: MassGIS (MBTA bus stops, rapid transit and commuter rail stations)
factors.description: MBTA bus stops, subway and commuter-rail stations within 1 km of the tract's centre.

factors.label: Libraries & places of worship nearby
factors.description: Public libraries and places of worship within 1 km of the tract's centre.

factors.label: People of color
factors.description: Share of residents who are not non-Hispanic white.

factors.label: Foreign-born (immigrants)
factors.description: Share of residents born outside the United States.

factors.label: Limited-English households
factors.description: Households where no one aged 14+ speaks English very well.

factors.label: Below poverty line
factors.description: Share of residents with income below the federal poverty line.

factors.label: In a state EJ population area
factors.description: Share of residents living in block groups Massachusetts designates as Environmental Justice populations (by minority share, income and/or limited English).

factors.label: Social Vulnerability Index
factors.description: CDC's overall social vulnerability ranking within Massachusetts (1 = most vulnerable).

factors.label: Frequent mental distress (est.)
factors.description: Estimated % of adults with 14+ poor mental-health days a month; modelled largely from demographics.

factors.label: Depression (est.)
factors.description: Estimated % of adults ever diagnosed with depression; modelled largely from demographics.

factors.label: Loneliness (est.)
factors.description: Estimated % of adults who feel lonely; modelled largely from demographics.
